brief: The scene depicts a constant flow of text appearing in black characters across an antique, cream-colored surface. The text continually streams across the vintage paper, causing the material to physically warp and buckle. This automatic writing action generates increasingly deep creases that permanently mark the paper. As the stream continues, the accumulating structural stress causes the aged surface to develop visible, fine hairline fractures that spiderweb across the visible material, documenting the passage of time.

statement: This sketch depicts the passage of time through the physical act of writing on aged paper. As text continuously flows across the canvas, it creates both visible creases and microscopic fractures in the paper's surface. The characters appear and move with a gentle warping effect, while the accumulated stress from the text stream manifests as permanent structural changes — hairline cracks that spiderweb outward from each character position. The effect suggests how writing imprints not just information but physical memory onto material surfaces, documenting the continuous process of aging and decay through mechanical stress.
